# App Event

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

Something that happened during app processing.

## Scope note

Events originated within a specific application (PKMMeals, PKMStudio), distinct from DeviceEvent (OS/hardware) and ServiceEvent (backend).

## Broader

- [Tool Event](../ToolEvent/) — generic (ISO 25964)
